excerpts: What we do AI agents for the work that happens inside documents. Most enterprise data lives in documents — invoices ... citations.title: Nanonets Overview
excerpts: Nanonets Overview Nanonets is an AI-driven solution that automates document processing and data extraction workflows. Leveraging advanced Optical Character Recognition (OCR) and deep learning models, Nanonets helps companies automate document-heavy business processes like accounts payable, order processing and insurance underwriting. Nanonets processes unstructured documents such as invoices, receipts, purchase orders, contracts, claims, and forms
